item.title: Podcast: The Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST)
item.description: NSF Noirlab's Robert Blum discusses the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's main mission, the Legacy Survey of Space and Time, and its transformative potential.

item.title: Potatoes may have given Indigenous Andeans a digestive edge
item.description: The rise of the potato in the Andes appears to have left a lasting mark on human DNA, with Indigenous Peruvians carrying unusually high numbers of a starch-related gene.

item.title: For 15,000 years, humans and dogs have shaped each other
item.description: Dogs and humans have influenced each other's evolution for about 15,000 years, from early hunter-gatherer partnerships to a wide variety of breeds.

item.title: Rare total solar eclipse to darken Europe: Watch live
item.description: A total solar eclipse will darken parts of Europe on August 12, 2026, with Spain offering prime viewing. ESA will provide a live stream.
